summary: End-to-end UI testing of the new 'Attach to quote' parse-free upload flow (FilesSec.jsx + POST /api/parser/files/upload). All 5 acceptance criteria pass: attach-without-parse works, files persist across save+reload via the draft→quote reassign migration, preview modal opens with correct content, delete works, and the existing Build Estimate parser flow remains unaffected.

evidence.note: Draft→quote reassign migration confirmed working — file survived Save Quote + full page reload.

evidence.preview rendered correct text content: This is a test RFQ reference file for SPOT corrugated quoting. / Customer: TestCo / Qty: 1000

evidence.comment: Build Estimate flow unchanged; existing parser code path unaffected.

critical_code_review_comments: FilesSec.jsx now 734 lines (above the 700-line guideline) — the ReviewParseModal sub-component (~380 lines starting L353) could be split into its own file for maintainability. Not a bug, just hygiene.

attachFiles() uses filesQuoteId = s.quoteId || active?.id — the same id stream the parser uses, so the draft→quote reassign hook in autoSave/Toolbar.onSave naturally covers attach-without-parse files. Implementation is clean and reuses the proven persistence path.

success_rate.backend: 100% (curl-verified by main agent, plus the upload+list path exercised here via UI)

seed_data_creation: Used estimate SA-260616-183745 (default new tab). Attached file test_attach_rfq.txt (90 B). Deleted at end of test — no lingering test data in saved files. Customer ident field was filled with TEST_AttachCo (in CUSTOMER IDENT input; the top-level CUSTOMER field requires the customer-search picker — not blocking since the quote/estimate id used is the active draft id which already persists files server-side).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug 3 (attach RFQ files without parsing) is fully working end-to-end through the UI. Network-level verification: exactly one POST /api/parser/files/upload fires on Attach to quote, zero POST /api/parser/parse-rfq calls (parser correctly skipped). Saved file persists after page reload, proving the draft→quote id reassign migration in Toolbar.onSave handles parse-free uploads identically to parser-persisted files. FilePreviewModal renders text content inline. All testids (sec-files, files-drop-zone, files-browse-input, files-list, btn-attach-files, saved-rfq-files, saved-rfq-<id>, saved-rfq-dl-<id>, saved-rfq-rm-<id>, btn-build-estimate, parser-inline-spinner, parse-review-modal) are present and selectable.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature already implemented correctly by main agent. Verified: FilesSec.attachFiles() → uploadParserFiles(raw, filesQuoteId) → POST /parser/files/upload → server persists with source='upload' (NO Anthropic call) → listParserFiles refreshes savedFiles → staged list cleared. On Save Quote, the draft id is reassigned to the persistent quote id via /parser/files/reassign, so the uploaded files survive reload.
